Scheer Rowlett & Associates Investment Management LTD Has Raised Position in Bank Of Montreal (BMO) by $8.40 Million; Celgene (CELG) Position Raised by Yhb Investment Advisors Inc
April 27, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Yhb Investment Advisors Inc increased its stake in Celgene Corp (CELG) by 10.43% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Yhb Investment Advisors Inc bought 7,777 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.30% with the market. The institutional investor held 82,332 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.59 million, up from 74,555 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Yhb Investment Advisors Inc who had been investing in Celgene Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $68.11 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.66% or $1.53 $90.55. About 2.03 million shares traded. Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) has declined 31.28% downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.83% the S&P500.
Scheer Rowlett & Associates Investment Management Ltd increased its stake in Bank Of Montreal (BMO) by 11.82% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Scheer Rowlett & Associates Investment Management Ltd bought 105,016 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.54% with the market. The institutional investor held 993,101 shares of the commercial banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $79.73 million, up from 888,085 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Scheer Rowlett & Associates Investment Management Ltd who had been investing in Bank Of Montreal for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $49.41B market cap company. The stock increased 0.54% or $0.41 $76.44. About 94,469 shares traded. Bank of Montreal (NYSE:BMO) has risen 0.84% uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.71% the S&P500.
Among 13 analysts covering Bank Of Montreal ( NYSE:BMO ), 4 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 9 Hold. Therefore 31% are positive. Bank Of Montreal had 29 analyst reports since August 4, The rating was upgraded by Barclays Capital on Tuesday, May 23 to “Equal-Weight”. On Thursday, May 26 the stock rating was downgraded by Scotia Capital to “Sector Perform”. The stock of Bank of Montreal (NYSE:BMO) earned “Neutral” rating by Credit Suisse on Wednesday, November 23. Bank of America reinitiated the shares of BMO in report on Tuesday, November 1 with “Neutral” rating. Dundee Securities initiated the shares of BMO in report on Wednesday, September 21 with “Neutral” rating. The rating was upgraded by Canaccord Genuity to “Buy” on Wednesday, December 7. The stock of Bank of Montreal (NYSE:BMO) has “Neutral” rating given on Tuesday, March 8 by Credit Suisse. The company was downgraded on Thursday, May 26 by TD Securities. TD Securities upgraded the shares of BMO in report on Wednesday, December 2 to “Buy” rating. The stock of Bank of Montreal (NYSE:BMO) has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, May 26 by Canaccord Genuity.
Scheer Rowlett & Associates Investment Management Ltd, which manages about $1.71 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Canadian Pacific Railway Ltd. (NYSE:CP) by 39,558 shares to 287,133 shares, valued at $52.63M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Agrium Inc. (NYSE:AGU) by 15,598 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 724,464 shares, and cut its stake in Methanex Corp. (NASDAQ:MEOH).
Yhb Investment Advisors Inc, which manages about $966.41M and $586.85M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Procter & Gamble Co (NYSE:PG) by 14,359 shares to 54,583 shares, valued at $5.02 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2,203 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 122,724 shares, and cut its stake in Kinder Morgan Inc Del (NYSE:KMI).
Since February 8, 2018, it had 1 insider purchase, and 3 insider sales for $3.58 million activity. On Thursday, February 15 the insider KAPLAN GILLA sold $1.77M. Another trade for 9,250 shares valued at $851,093 was made by LOUGHLIN JAMES J on Monday, March 12. Alles Mark J also bought $299,594 worth of Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) on Thursday, February 8.
Among 34 analysts covering Celgene Corporation ( NASDAQ:CELG ), 19 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 14 Hold. Therefore 56% are positive. Celgene Corporation had 142 analyst reports since July 21, The firm has “Buy” rating by Jefferies given on Wednesday, October 5. The company was initiated on Friday, July 15 by Stifel Nicolaus. Suntrust Robinson maintained Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) on Friday, April 29 with “Buy” rating. As per Tuesday, January 23, the company rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets. The rating was downgraded by Argus Research to “Hold” on Friday, May 5. Jefferies initiated it with “Buy” rating and $16000 target in Monday, July 10 report. Canaccord Genuity maintained the shares of CELG in report on Friday, October 27 with “Buy” rating.
